decisions.rationale: The existing fixture places the signed decision below broker.root, so it cannot distinguish the reproduced external evidence-root rejection from the repaired behavior. One deterministic host-only regression directly covering the valid external decision path protects the exact acceptance-blocking behavior with negligible maintenance and no product expansion.
decisions.smallest_fix: Adapt the focused retained-session controller test surface so one valid signed decision is stored outside broker.root, reaches authorization derivation and retained execution, and proves the existing decision path/hash binding; add no production change, path abstraction, unrelated matrix, MCP launch, or hardware action.
